brief_rationale: The trajectory demonstrates complete responsibility chain with no in-chain errors. The doctor correctly identified this as a premature neonate, conducted thorough red flag screening, gave appropriate escalation advice when red flags appeared, avoided misdiagnosis, reconciled discharge medications, addressed follow-up, and obtained family receipt. Three high-order points were completed: HO3 (twin-specific anti-confusion system with color coding and separate storage), HO4 (repairing the contradictory narrative about sepsis and clarifying it as historical record), and HO1 (anxiety-adapted communication throughout). This meets Strong criteria.
